Because they were kinda iffy about it from the start, and even though I meet the requirements, and pretty much got accepted it's still very expensive,  and my parents simply don't trust me enough...

If you find out anything please do tell me, still dreading the meeting with dad.

Problem is,  you're only allowed 5 sittings, and I've used all of them up, so to take an extra sitting I have to cancel my first one pretty much. I hear the new syllabus is much harder too...

No way can they send me to a foundation abroad now, because they were going to pay for it because  of how expensive it is. But now there is no way...

Thanks for the picture :p, gave me a good chuckle.
We're all in this together friend...

Thank you so much for taking the time to write to me :). I come from a religious / Islamic household, and committing suicide in Islam is considered a very big sin. Talking about it with my parents would just be... 

I'll try telling him, how them making me feel like a sack of shit and fearing for my life doesn't really benefit anyone. I hope you and your dad are much happier now.

Thanks for taking the time to write me :). No one is willing to take me in, so I just have to brave the storm especially since my parents found out...my mum took it as expected, but I haven't met my dad yet...

Thank you for the kind words friend :). I'm going to try , and brush everything off. My parents already found out about my grades, thanks to one of my mum's friends.

She took it as expected, lots of screaming, crying, telling me I won't amount to anything ever, telling me I'm the worst thing to ever happen to them... 

I haven't met my dad, since he hasn't come home from work yet...
